passes: Pass 1: the loop's layout as written. Feed: plain ink tag at 860-898, ink card at 940, no scrim; clean render, but the price, line and offer fell to 3.8-4.3:1 on the floor's darker foot, and the kit's coral-deep lozenge was almost invisible. Pass 2: Feed tag up to 851-889 (closer to the shadows than to the wordmark, so it reads as the picture's caption) and a lift scrim in the floor's own lit terracotta from 960, which took the lower card to 4.7+:1 without touching the shadows. Story headline on one line at Velista 72 (the b03-1 Story pattern) with 'GOLD TONE.' in gold-light; rows re-spaced (362, 470, 550, 640). Checked at full size and at 216 px beside win_static_hoops_apricot, lose_p2_proof_parody, win_twenty_f2_tennis_ruby and b03-1/b03-2 (Feed), and win_w1_woven_red_story, lose_vks5_prism_close and b03-1/b03-2 (Story): the hoops land first on both, the float reads, the card is legible.

Pass 3: the Feed lozenge set to ink with a selector that outranks the kit's light-ground rule (it had disappeared in pass 2); the Story tag moved from 640 to 648 so it sits as the hoops' caption rather than under the offer box, its line box ending at 686, 25 px over the posts. Re-rendered and re-measured.

copyChanges: None to the b03-4 brief's words. Primary text 160 characters, the offer ends at character 125; Meta headline 35 (40 max), description 22. No claim and no water anywhere: Monochrome Enamel Hoops carries no Waterproof, Tarnish Free or Hypoallergenic tag (RULINGS section 1.1). Lint: no diamond, real or solid gold, freshwater, bare gold or silver, emerald or ruby, PVD, steel, 18k, 'pair', compare-at price or free shipping.
Two-code offer box reads CODES BUY2 · 10% OFF ◆ BUY3 · 20% OFF (two codes, so CODES, RULINGS section 2).
The Story headline runs on one line ('BLACK. WHITE. GOLD TONE.') instead of the brief's two, for the space reason in passes; the words are unchanged.

Not applied (one critic only, logged for the lead): A's Meta primary text 'Black, white, gold tone: Monochrome Enamel Hoops, ₹999, a black and a white enamel stripe on each. BUY2: 10% off 2 pieces. For the white shirt, or all black.' (157 characters, the offer ends at 122; A flags the live 'one black and one white enamel stripe a hoop' as ungrammatical). B asked for no copy change. 19 Nov 23:35 UTC zero-credit pass (b04 loop change 4): Meta primary text replaced with critic A's grammatical version (157 characters, offer ends at 122); old and new in final. JPGs unchanged.
truthNotes: Verifier (b03 verify.md) and my own zooms: per hoop exactly one black and one white enamel stripe between three polished gold-tone rails, an open C, the post at the top, a plain ridged gold-tone inside, zero stones; the pair identical in the pack ref's three-quarter pose. Hoop H/W 1.34 against the pack ref's 1.37 at the same pose.

Float: each shadow lies directly below its hoop with a clear gap of floor (0.41x the hoop height), no wire or stand. Overhead L6 gives soft parallelogram footprints, the physically right shadow of an upright hoop.
Scale: 19.9 Feed px/mm, about 1.25x life size on a phone, declared by the size tag on both placements. Pair width 60.7% of the Feed width.

Pre-launch check (critic B, open): re-read Monochrome Enamel Hoops stock before launch. It read 24 at the b04 pre-flight, 4 over the 20 floor (RULINGS §2); do not launch below 20. The SKU carries no claim and no water, and none is printed (correct).

Critic B truth note (not a fail): the gold tone picks up the terracotta bounce (median hue 67°, C* 39-40, against the detail ref's 73° and 37): warm, not brassy. Construction matches both refs: one black and one white stripe, three rails, an open C, a ridged inside. Rule note (B): this is b03-4 try 1, which never shipped; keep b03-4 marked dropped in the ledger (it is) so the picture is never used twice.
abTest: First live read of a float (the crazy slot is 0 for 5 over three batches), and the first ink-on-light card in ads-500 (the floor under the card is light terracotta). Read it against the b03 product-only ads as a picture test; the offer is the standard two-code box, so it is not an offer cell.
deployment: Feed and Story both carry the card and the size tag; the headline is on the Story only. Not scored yet.
